packageRules.description: CI tests against prod's engine: ol-mitlearn-db-production runs postgres 15.17.
Local compose stays a major ahead of prod for now; this keeps 16.x patches flowing without offering 17+.
Keep the local server in the series qdrant-client ~=1.18.0 targets.

posthog-js 1.350.0+ skips the page-load /flags request when init bootstraps flags, which deployed envs always do. 1.297.2 is what production runs; frozen there rather than capped at <1.350.0 because the 105 releases in between are untested here. Remove this rule with mitodl/mit-learn#4206, which lands the upgrade with the handling it needs.
Digest pins on local dev compose images are churn without a supply-chain benefit; Dockerfiles and Actions keep them.
